title: Games made with Unity: May 2026 in review
summary: Stay updated with the latest game releases from the Unity community. Explore our list of standout games made with Unity in May 2026.
body_markdown:
***A lot happened in games in the month of May: hotly anticipated life sim* Paralives *officially entered early access, ZA/UM launched* ZERO PARADES: For Dead Spies *to critical acclaim, and Steam officially recognized Bullet Heaven as its own distinct game genre. Get the full recap in our summary of Made with Unity games for May 2026.***


## Award-winning Unity games: May 2026


Looking at this month’s game awards ceremonies, Unity developers were well-represented around the world.


### gamescom LATAM – BIG Festival Awards 2026


- [Is This Seat Taken?](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3035120/Is_This_Seat_Taken/) by Poti Poti Studio **(Best Casual Game)**
- [Moomintroll: Winter’s Warmth](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3256150/Moomintroll_Winters_Warmth/) by Hyper Games **(Best Art)**
- [Goodnight Universe](https://store.steampowered.com/app/2416100/Goodnight_Universe/) by Nice Dream **(Innovation)**
- [A Rat’s Quest: The Way Back Home](https://store.steampowered.com/app/1124420/A_Rats_Quest__The_Way_Back_Home__Season_1/) by The Dreamerians **(Best Game: Latin America)**
- [WHAT THE CLASH?](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/what-the-clash) by Triband ( **Best Mobile Game)**
- [Jolly Match: First MR Match-3 Puzzles](https://www.meta.com/experiences/jolly-match-first-mr-match-3-puzzles/) by **(Best XR/VR Game)**
- *[I Don’t Want To Be A Good Woman](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3779700/I_Dont_Want_To_Be_A_Good_Woman/)* by We Remember **(BIG Impact)**
- [Tavern Keeper](https://store.steampowered.com/app/436780/Tavern_Keeper/) by Greenheart Games **(Best New Game)**


### Pavs Game Awards 2026


We were excited to see Unity titles winning seven of the nine total prizes at the 2026 New Zealand’s Pavs Game Awards, including:


- [Total Chaos](https://store.steampowered.com/app/2208350/Total_Chaos/) by Trigger Happy Interactive **(Slice of Heaven: Grand Prize)**
- [Beyond These Stars](https://store.steampowered.com/app/2295060/Beyond_These_Stars/) by Balancing Monkey Games Limited **(The Accessible Ambrosia: Excellence in Accessibility)**
- [Toroa: Skycall](https://store.steampowered.com/app/2003490/Toroa_Skycall/) by Atawhai Interactive **(The Diverse Delight: Excellence in Representation)**
- [Beyond These Stars](https://store.steampowered.com/app/2295060/Beyond_These_Stars/) by Balancing Monkey Games Limited **(The Perfect Slice: Excellence in Design)**
- [Rollick N’ Roll](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3274880/Rollick_N_Roll/) by Crayonix Games **(The Decorative Piece: Excellence in Visual Art)**
- [Teeto](https://store.steampowered.com/app/2783370/Teeto/) by Eat Pant Games **(The Composed Segment: Excellence in Audio)**
- [The Drifter](https://store.steampowered.com/app/1170570/The_Drifter/) by Powerhoof **(The Guest Plate: Excellence in Games from Across the Ditch \[Australia\])**


### Nordic Game Awards 2026


- [Discounty](https://store.steampowered.com/app/2274620/Discounty/) by Crinkle Cut Games **(Best Debut)**
- [LEGO® Voyagers](https://store.steampowered.com/app/1538550/LEGO_Voyagers) by Light Brick Studio **(Best Fun For Everyone)**
